caption: The drawing features a single object, a rectangular mirror with an ornate wooden frame, centered on a plain, off-white background. The frame is a medium to dark brown color with intricate, symmetrical scrollwork details on the top and bottom edges and a slightly less ornate treatment on the sides. At the very top of the frame, there is a carved decorative motif featuring a bird with outstretched wings in a lighter brown and yellowish color, perched among additional scrolling elements. The mirror surface occupies the central area and appears to reflect indistinct vertical shapes in soft gray, blue, and white tones. A thin gold border lines the inner edge of the frame, accentuating the reflective area. The name "WELLINGTON BLEWETT" is written in small, uppercase letters near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Mirror
